limits: Only one physical Linux host/kernel and one MediaMTX build; not a release artifact or full catalog certification.
Response-only selected-cookie packet evidence; no captured requests, process attribution or request/CSeq dialogue correlation in production.
Complete contiguous RTSP/1.0 headers must start at packet offset zero and end within 512 bytes. No cross-packet reconstruction, body parsing, RTSP/2.0 or arbitrary method/outcome detection.
CSeq ordering and session equality are independently verified by the fixture, not inferred by product predicates.
404 recovery uses a new connection; 461 UDP SETUP refusal is followed by successful TCP SETUP on the same connection.
Generic 200, session-only keepalive/PAUSE, range-only replies and body-only header text are negative controls, not PLAY proof.
A signature-shaped body at a new packet boundary still requires dialogue context these packet-local predicates do not supply.
No authentication/TLS, UDP media/multicast, RTP delivery/loss/jitter/media quality, throughput or multi-host/kernel coverage.
Default sparse collectors retain unsupported-offset diagnostics; this proof supplies a 1024-byte contiguous validation prefix without changing the ordinary streaming ABI.
